basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate from Toronto, Canada, navigating my way through the CPA exam journey. I have a keen interest in finance and accounting, but I'm also a huge fan of video games, especially Adopt Me on Roblox. I dislike unstructured study materials and exams with unexpected content. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. Currently, I'm working as a junior accountant at a local firm. I'm single and enjoy connecting with others who are in the same boat with their CPA exams.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting and have been self-teaching various CPA exam materials through online courses and study groups. My knowledge is primarily rooted in academic learning with some practical exposure from my current job.
